_comment: Mode 'source' (C3): take a playlist/channel/search, use the YouTube caption transcript when it exists, and only Whisper-transcribe clips that have NO caption. Set ONE of playlist_id / channel / search; leave the others out. 'limit' caps how many videos are considered. 'languages' are the caption languages tried before Whisper (omit to use code/languages.json). Most videos have captions, so a run may Whisper nothing, that is the correct 'only fill gaps' behavior. Keep 'limit' small; each Whisper fallback is slow.
